non_claims: the acyl group (benzoyl versus angeloyl or tigloyl) is decided by the precursor composition, not by these ions
positional isomers such as schisantherin A and gomisin G, and angeloyl versus tigloyl esters, are not resolved

notes: Ion-trap MS2 of [M+H]+ or [M+NH4]+ of C6-acyloxy dibenzocyclooctadienes gives only [M+H-acid]+ 415; 371 (-C2H4O) is seen only on MS3 or the in-source 415 ion (Huang 2007, Shi 2009), so one MS2 ion is shown and the rule is not measured.

competitors.note: Schisandrin [M+H-H2O]+ is a nominal 415 ion of another formula (C24H31O6+, 36 mDa away) that loses a methoxyl radical rather than C2H4O (jms.1246).

priors.note: The C6 esters were fragmented from [M+NH4]+ in one paper and from [M+H]+ in the other; both give the [M+H-acid]+ ion.
